meta.title: Settings
meta.description: Change how the site works without waiting for a release.

adminSettings.title: Settings
adminSettings.lead: Change how the site works without waiting for a release. A change applies at once, needs a fresh check with your authenticator app or passkey, and goes in the audit log.

denied.title: Only a super admin can open settings
denied.body: Your account doesn't have the super admin role. If a setting needs changing, ask a super admin.

minMembershipDays.label: Ambassador minimum membership duration
minMembershipDays.description: Whole days since joining the FOA community, while currently an active member. Provisional HR-57 default.

minAgeYears.label: Ambassador minimum age
minAgeYears.description: Completed years on the Indian calendar. Ambassador applications are adult-only; this cannot be set below 18.

qualifyingMilestones.label: Ambassador qualifying milestones
qualifyingMilestones.description: A comma-separated list, with no spaces, of one or more earned milestones; any one counts. Allowed values: participant, school_winner, foa_finalist, volunteer.

staffSessionHours.label: Staff session length
staffSessionHours.description: How long staff stay signed in before they must sign in again. Lowering it also signs out staff whose session is already older.

emailSignIn.label: Sign-in codes by email
emailSignIn.description: Lets people sign up and sign in with a code by email. Turning it off makes the sign-in pages say sign-in opens soon. On the live site it also needs Amazon SES set up and approved to send to anyone.

enabled.label: Sign-in codes by text message
enabled.description: Lets people get sign-in codes by SMS. Keep it off until FOA's messages are registered on the DLT platform.

maxPerHour.label: Sign-in texts per hour
maxPerHour.description: The most sign-in codes sent by SMS in one hour, to everyone together. It caps FOA's SMS bill; once it is reached, people sign in by email until the hour ends.

maxPerDay.label: Sign-in texts per day
maxPerDay.description: The most sign-in codes sent by SMS in one day (midnight to midnight UTC), to everyone together. It caps FOA's SMS bill; once it is reached, people sign in by email until the day ends.

recurringEnabled.label: Monthly donations
recurringEnabled.description: Accept recurring donations once the subscription gateway is configured and approved.

enabled.label: Online donations
enabled.description: Lets people give on the donate page. Keep it off until Razorpay's live keys are set and the accountant has confirmed receipts and the chart of accounts; until then the page says donations open soon.

allowGuest.label: Donations without an account
allowGuest.description: Lets someone give without signing in. Their receipt link goes to the email address they type.

minAmountRupees.label: Smallest donation
minAmountRupees.description: The least one online donation may be, in whole rupees.

maxAmountRupees.label: Largest donation
maxAmountRupees.description: The most one online donation may be, in whole rupees. Larger gifts come by bank transfer, arranged with FOA.

pendingExpiryHours.label: Time to finish paying
pendingExpiryHours.description: How long a donation waits for its payment before it expires. Money that arrives later goes to payment review.

has80G.label: 80G registration held
has80G.description: Turn on once FOA holds 80G registration, so donors in India get tax receipts.

fcraEnabled.label: Foreign donations (FCRA)
fcraEnabled.description: Turn on once FOA is registered under FCRA and may accept donations from abroad.

legalName.label: Registered name
legalName.description: FOA's legal name as registered. It shows on receipts, the donate and about pages and the policies. Production leaves it out while it is empty.

registrationType.label: Registration type
registrationType.description: How FOA is registered, for example "Section 8 company" or "Public charitable trust".

registrationNumber.label: Registration number
registrationNumber.description: FOA's registration number, as on its certificate of registration.

pan.label: PAN
pan.description: FOA's Permanent Account Number, 10 characters. It goes on donation receipts.

foaFacilityAddress.label: Artwork receiving address
foaFacilityAddress.description: The confirmed FOA facility address to which original artworks are couriered. Leave blank to refuse live requests.

reportsPerIpPerHour.label: Safeguarding reports per hour from one connection
reportsPerIpPerHour.description: The most concerns the report form takes from one internet connection in an hour. Past it, the form shows Childline 1098, 112 and FOA's safeguarding email instead, so nobody is left without help.

authorityEmail.label: Authority's address for breach notices
authorityEmail.description: Where the breach log emails a notice to the authority, such as the Data Protection Board. Leave it empty until FOA's lawyer confirms the address: staff then file the notice by hand and record the reference they get.

manualEntryApprovalThresholdRupees.label: Manual entries that need a second approver
manualEntryApprovalThresholdRupees.description: A manual ledger entry moving more than this many rupees waits until a second finance user approves it. Entries at or below it post at once. Set 0 to send every manual entry for approval.

approvalExpiryDays.label: Days a finance request waits for approval
approvalExpiryDays.description: A period lock, a reopening or a large manual entry that nobody approves or rejects in this many days expires, and finance has to ask again.

accountantExport.label: Accountant's ledger export
accountantExport.description: Lets finance download the ledger as a CSV journal for FOA's accountant. Keep it off until the accountant has confirmed the columns and the date rules.

requestDueDays.label: Days to answer an access or correction request
requestDueDays.description: Days the grievance officer has to answer a request to see or correct someone's data. The queue flags a request once its due date passes. FOA's lawyer still needs to confirm the period (HR-30).

erasureDueDays.label: Days to answer an erasure request
erasureDueDays.description: Days the grievance officer has to act on a request to erase someone's data, which also withdraws their consents. FOA's lawyer still needs to confirm the period (HR-30).

exportLinkHours.label: Hours a data export can be downloaded
exportLinkHours.description: How long the person's download link to a copy of their data works. The copy is deleted when the link stops working.

erasureEnabled.label: Erase data on request
erasureEnabled.description: Lets the grievance officer carry out an erasure they have previewed. Erasing can't be undone. Leave it off until FOA's lawyer confirms what an erasure must keep (HR-30).

erasureKeepsPayerAccount.label: Keep a payer's account while their payment records are kept
erasureKeepsPayerAccount.description: When on, erasing a person who paid FOA keeps their name and contact on their account until 8 years after the payment's financial year ends, so the payment still names who paid. Everything else is erased. When off, the account is deleted and the payment records stay without the payer's name.

enabled.label: Clubs open
enabled.description: Allows club applications, approval and joining. Keep off until M6 safeguarding is signed off.

maxPerInstitution.label: Maximum clubs per institution
maxPerInstitution.description: Approved and suspended clubs share this cap. Between 1 and 20.

applicationsOpen.label: Volunteer applications open
applicationsOpen.description: Lets members apply to volunteer from their dashboard. Keep it off until FOA's safeguarding lead and lawyer have approved the volunteer declarations and police checks are in place for anyone who will work near children.

minAgeYears.label: Youngest age to volunteer
minAgeYears.description: Anyone younger is refused when they apply. Between 13 and 18.

guardianApprovalBelowAgeYears.label: Guardian approval needed below this age
guardianApprovalBelowAgeYears.description: An applicant younger than this needs a verified guardian on the platform, who approves before a community manager sees the application. Between 18 and 21.

minAdopterAgeYears.label: Youngest age to adopt
minAdopterAgeYears.description: Anyone younger is refused when they apply to adopt an animal. Between 18 and 25.

eventStartsFirstHours.label: First event reminder
eventStartsFirstHours.description: Hours before an event starts to remind confirmed attendees. Use 0 to disable.

eventStartsSecondHours.label: Second event reminder
eventStartsSecondHours.description: Hours before an event starts to send a second reminder. Use 0 to disable.

entrySubmissionDueFirstHours.label: First reminder before submissions close
entrySubmissionDueFirstHours.description: How many hours before a competition's submission deadline the first reminder goes to everyone who still owes an entry: an adult who entered, a child's guardian, or a school's coordinators. Use 0 for no first reminder. A change applies to reminders not yet sent.

entrySubmissionDueSecondHours.label: Second reminder before submissions close
entrySubmissionDueSecondHours.description: How many hours before the submission deadline the second reminder goes, to whoever still owes an entry then. Use 0 for no second reminder.

schoolRoundShortlistDueFirstHours.label: First reminder before school shortlists close
schoolRoundShortlistDueFirstHours.description: Hours before the shortlist deadline to remind coordinators of unfinished school rounds. Use 0 for no first reminder.

schoolRoundShortlistDueSecondHours.label: Second reminder before school shortlists close
schoolRoundShortlistDueSecondHours.description: Hours before the shortlist deadline for the second reminder, to coordinators whose rounds remain unfinished. Use 0 to turn it off.

resubmissionDays.label: Days to resubmit a sent-back entry
resubmissionDays.description: When an FOA verifier sends an entry back, the participant, guardian or coordinator has this many days to fix it and resubmit. After that the entry stays sent back. Between 1 and 60; a change applies to entries sent back after it.

enforce.label: Delete expired records
enforce.description: Lets the daily retention run at 02:15 delete and anonymise records past their retention period. While it is off, the run only counts them and records the counts in the audit log. Turn it on once FOA's counsel has confirmed the periods below.

expiredVerificationsDays.label: Keep expired sign-in codes
expiredVerificationsDays.description: Days a sign-in code or link is kept after it expires, then the daily run deletes it.

expiredSessionsDays.label: Keep expired sessions
expiredSessionsDays.description: Days a sign-in session, with the network address and browser it recorded, is kept after it expires.

capturedMessagesDays.label: Keep captured test messages
capturedMessagesDays.description: Days a message captured instead of sent (local runs and previews only) is kept.

messageDeliveriesDays.label: Keep the message log
messageDeliveriesDays.description: Days the record of each email, text or in-app message sent is kept.

readInboxItemsDays.label: Keep read in-app messages
readInboxItemsDays.description: Days an in-app message is kept after the person reads it. Unread messages stay while the account is open.

quarantinedFilesDays.label: Keep quarantined files
quarantinedFilesDays.description: Days a flagged file and its stored object are kept after quarantine.

dispatchedOutboxDays.label: Keep finished background jobs
dispatchedOutboxDays.description: Days a background job that ran is kept. A job that failed stays until staff resolve it.

coordinatorInvitationLinksDays.label: Clear expired coordinator invitation links
coordinatorInvitationLinksDays.description: Days after a coordinator invitation expires unanswered before its link's secret is cleared.

guardianInvitationLinksDays.label: Clear expired guardian invitation links
guardianInvitationLinksDays.description: Days after a guardian's or teen's invitation expires unanswered before its link's secret is cleared.

coordinatorInvitationsDays.label: Keep closed coordinator invitations
coordinatorInvitationsDays.description: Days a coordinator invitation is kept after it is accepted, withdrawn or expires.

guardianInvitationsDays.label: Keep closed guardian invitations
guardianInvitationsDays.description: Days a teen-login invitation or a teen's guardian request is kept after it is accepted, withdrawn or expires.

contactMessagesMonths.label: Keep closed contact messages
contactMessagesMonths.description: Calendar months a closed contact message and its staff notes are kept.

volunteerApplicationsDays.label: Keep closed volunteer applications
volunteerApplicationsDays.description: Days a volunteer application that was declined or withdrawn is kept after it closes, then the daily run deletes it. An approved application stays while the person volunteers.

adoptionApplicationsDays.label: Keep closed adoption applications
adoptionApplicationsDays.description: Days a closed adoption application, with its success story, is kept after it closes, then the daily run deletes it. One whose story is published stays while the story is up.

releasedLegalHoldsDays.label: Keep released legal holds
releasedLegalHoldsDays.description: Days a legal hold is kept, as the record of what was held and why, after it is released.

financialRecordsDays.label: Keep payment records
financialRecordsDays.description: Days a payment, its refunds and its reviews are kept whole before the payer's details are removed. Payment records always stay at least until 8 years after the end of their financial year, whatever this says.

privacyRequestsDays.label: Keep closed privacy requests
privacyRequestsDays.description: Days a privacy request and the grievance officer's notes are kept after the request is closed. Open requests are always kept.

ambassadorApplicationsDays.label: Retention of declined ambassador applications
ambassadorApplicationsDays.description: Days after decline before deletion, unless legally held. HR-31 remains provisional.

clubApplicationsDays.label: Anonymise closed club records
clubApplicationsDays.description: Days after closure, decline or withdrawal before the applicant and reviewer links and decision text are removed.

clubMembershipsDays.label: Keep former club memberships
clubMembershipsDays.description: Days after leaving a club before the private membership record is removed; the person's engagement timeline remains until erasure.

communityMembersDays.label: Keep former member profiles
communityMembersDays.description: Days after departure before the daily retention job clears a former member’s display name and introduction.

surveyResponsesDays.label: Keep survey invitations and answers
surveyResponsesDays.description: Days after a survey closes before invitations and linked answers are deleted.

returnWindowDays.label: Artwork return window
returnWindowDays.description: Days from actual publication of results that families may request their original work back.

dispatchDays.label: Artwork dispatch window
dispatchDays.description: Calendar days from request to the dispatch deadline.

dispatchReminderLeadHours.label: Dispatch reminder lead
dispatchReminderLeadHours.description: Hours before dispatch closes. Set 0 to turn off.

packagingInstructions.label: Packaging instructions
packagingInstructions.description: Instructions sent with each artwork request.

shippingPayer.label: FOA pays shipping
shippingPayer.description: When off, the sender pays shipping.

withdrawalPurgeMinutes.label: Gallery withdrawal purge deadline
withdrawalPurgeMinutes.description: Minutes from a guardian’s public-display withdrawal to confirmed cache purge. The gallery immediately refuses the item before this deadline.

reportsPerIpPerHour.label: Gallery reports per hour
reportsPerIpPerHour.description: Maximum gallery reports from one network each hour.

minIncrementPaise.label: Minimum bid increment
minIncrementPaise.description: Every bid after the first must raise the highest accepted bid by at least this many paise (100 paise = ₹1). The change applies to the next bid.

antiSnipingWindowMinutes.label: Late bid extension window
antiSnipingWindowMinutes.description: An accepted bid inside this many minutes before closing extends the exact closing time by the same number of minutes. Use 0 to disable extensions.

enabled.label: Enable auctions
enabled.description: Allow scheduling, public viewing and bidding on auction lots. Leave off until FOA and counsel approve auction eligibility and consent terms.

paymentWindowHours.label: Payment window
paymentWindowHours.description: Hours a winning bidder has to pay for the lot.

maxPaymentOffers.label: Maximum payment offers
maxPaymentOffers.description: Number of distinct buyers offered payment before the original is released for relisting.

enabled.label: Competition feedback surveys
enabled.description: Allow competition managers to send feedback surveys after published results, and respondents to answer. Off until FOA approves feedback surveys.
